description: Structural/semantic assertions for apps/demo-app, run against every region's fetched HTML. Prefer 'element exists + roughly right content' over a single brittle CSS selector, per CLAUDE.md §3 — a pure class rename should NOT fail these.

assertions.description: Hero heading element exists and still mentions the product name.
Price element exists and its text looks like a dollar amount.
Buy button exists and its label still reads as a buy action.
Buy status live-region exists (text may legitimately be empty pre-interaction).
